documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
INR was a touch high last month, nurse had him skip one dose; back in range today. Otherwise well. Fasting sugars about the same.
Exam: irregular, rate controlled. Lungs clear. Feet: intact sensation, no callus or ulcer.
A/P: AF/warfarin - in range, same dose. T2DM - A1c today. HTN - controlled. Tobacco - pack a day, again advised. RTC June.

documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine follow-up. Keeping busy with small carpentry jobs. No chest symptoms, no swelling, no bleeding.
Exam: rate controlled, irregularly irregular. Lungs clear. No edema.
A/P: All chronic problems stable on the same four medicines. A1c, BMP and INR today. Eye exam due next month. Smoking cessation offered, declined. AWV in September.

documents.title: Diabetic eye examination report
documents.author: optometry
documents.body: Dilated diabetic eye exam 7/18/2024. Known patient, T2DM on insulin; no drug allergies on file. Corrected acuity 20/25 each eye. Pressures within normal limits. Lenses clear. Retina: no diabetic changes either eye, maculae dry. Assessment: diabetes without retinopathy. Next exam 12 months.

orders.order: Low-dose CT chest for lung cancer screening

documents.title: Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Medicare wellness review, year two with us. Still independent; wife and he split the house and yard work. No falls. PHQ-2 0. Proxy form signed and scanned - wife is agent. Had RSV shot at the pharmacy last month.

Review: AF on warfarin, one high INR this year, otherwise steady. BP at goal. T2DM, A1c 7s, on glargine 20. CKD 3a stable. Eye exam in July without retinopathy.

Exam: irregular rhythm, no murmur. Lungs clear. Feet: normal monofilament, pulses present. No edema.

Plan: annual labs. Flu shot today. Lung CT due October, ordered. COVID shot at the next nurse INR visit. Smoking - still a pack a day. Advised again, declines help.

reports.study: Low-dose CT chest for lung cancer screening
reports.text: Indication: annual lung cancer screening. Technique: low-dose CT chest without contrast. Comparison: 10/10/2023 and 10/6/2022. Findings: lungs without nodules. No airspace disease. No pleural effusion. Heart normal size. Mediastinum unremarkable.

documents.title: INR and COVID vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Fingerstick INR in range; same dose. 2024-25 COVID vaccine given L deltoid. Tolerated. Lung CT result reviewed with pt - negative.
